verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Workers deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network with "no cold starts or region complexity" (cloudflare-docs-1, cloudflare-docs-19), and that Cloudflare runs deployed code across that network (cloudflare-supp-agents-sdk). Smart Placement is documented as an opt-in to move a Worker closer to its data instead (cloudflare-docs-16), implying it otherwise runs near users. Community reports describe Workers as very quick and note request-level geolocation headers, consistent with edge execution (cloudflare-comm-11, cloudflare-comm-1, cloudflare-comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that requests execute in the location nearest the end user (e.g., PoP count or coverage), and independent latency benchmarks corroborating edge proximity.
